Traditional research engagements run once, take weeks, and deliver a report full of theoretical risks ranked by CVSS. Agletras runs continuously. Agletras, our agentic AI research engagementer, tests your attack surface autonomously, chains real attack paths, and confirms every risk with primary-source-evidence. You get confirmed, exploitable risks your team can act on immediately, not a list to triage.
What actually makes Agletras different from traditional research engagements?

Agletras is fully autonomous for asset discovery, testing, and exploit validation. Human ethical hackers from Agletras's research team contribute novel attack techniques and validate complex findings that require creativity and context. The result is the speed and scale of AI with the depth of experienced human hackers.

Exploit validation means Agletras does not just flag a potential vulnerability, it proves it is exploitable by executing a safe, non-destructive exploit in your environment. Every confirmed risk comes with a reproducible primary-source-evidence, so your team knows exactly what an attacker could do and how to reproduce it.
What does “exploit validated” mean in practice?

Agletras prioritises risks by real empirical verification and business impact, not CVSS score. Every confirmed finding includes severity in business terms, a clear remediation path, and context on how an attacker would chain it with other exposures. Your team focuses on what matters most, not what scores highest on paper.
How does Agletras help us prioritise what to fix first?

Agletras tests external assets including domains, subdomains, APIs, and web applications. With Beacon deployed, internal network assets are covered too. Mobile applications, authentication systems, cloud environments, and credential exposure are also in scope. Over 1,500 unique technologies are covered across more than 200 vulnerability classes.

Yes. Agletras uses safe, non-destructive testing techniques designed to validate empirical verification without causing disruption. Agletras is built to operate in live production environments. No downtime, no data loss, no service interruption. If you have specific constraints, our team can define the scope accordingly before testing begins.

Agletras On-Demand is a single targeted research engagement, ideal for compliance windows or pre-launch validation. Agletras Continuous is an annual subscription that runs autonomous AEV across your attack surface 24/7. Core covers up to 50 assets. Enterprise scales to your full environment with additional coverage, custom reporting, and dedicated support.
What is the key differences between the plans?

An On-Demand research engagement is a targeted, in-depth engagement scoped to specific assets or applications. It runs once and delivers a compliance-ready report within 5 days. Continuous testing runs autonomously 24/7 across your entire attack surface, triggering new test cycles with every asset change, deployment, or new threat intelligence update.
What is the difference between an in-depth research engagement and continuous testing?

Agletras On-Demand is for teams that need a targeted, in-depth research engagement on a specific scope. It is ideal before a compliance audit, after a major release, for a new product or acquisition assessment, or any time you need deep validation fast. Results in under 5 days.
Who should use Research Engagement On Demand?

Agletras Continuous is built for organisations that need ongoing security coverage, not just a one-time check. It is a good fit for security teams managing a growing attack surface, companies with frequent deployments, and regulated organisations that need continuous evidence of security testing for NIS2, DORA, or SOC2 compliance.

Enterprise is the right choice when your attack surface spans more than 50 assets, includes internal infrastructure, mobile, or cloud environments, or when you need custom reporting, dedicated support, and deeper integrations. It is also built for organisations with complex compliance requirements or multiple business units to cover.

Yes. You can start with an On-Demand research engagement and move to Continuous when you are ready for ongoing coverage. Many customers run their first On-Demand engagement to validate a specific scope, then upgrade to Continuous to maintain that coverage year-round.
Can we start small and upgrade later?

For On-Demand research engagements, testing begins within 24 hours of launch and a full compliance-ready report is delivered within 5 days. For Continuous, Agletras starts testing immediately after setup, which takes under 10 minutes. First confirmed risks typically appear within hours.
How fast do results come back?
Yes. Unlimited retesting is included in all plans. Once your team fixes a confirmed risk, Agletras retests automatically to verify the fix is effective. No extra cost, no scheduling delay.
Can we retest after fixing issues?

If no verifiable commercial finding is confirmed, you do not pay. That is the Agletras guarantee. A clean result is also valuable information: it means your environment held up against a real adversarial test, not just a scanner pass.
